meta.title: Programmes: IIT JEE Courses in Pune | D-SAP
meta.description: JEE programmes for Class 11 (two years), Class 12 (one year) and a foundation for Class 9 and 10, powered by a top Kota institute.

intro.text: Three programmes, by the class your child is in: two years from Class 11, one year in Class 12, and a foundation programme for Class 9 and 10.
We do not run a separate batch for students taking a drop year.

sections.heading: Choose by class
body: Each programme page covers who it is for, what it covers, a normal week and the tests.

sections.heading: The programmes side by side
body: Who each programme is for, how long it runs, what it prepares for and the batch size.

body.text: Study material for the whole syllabus: theory notes, solved examples, chapter-wise problem sets at Main and Advanced level, and past IIT JEE papers with solutions.
A practice sheet every week. A doubts forum and doubt sessions, plus one-on-one mentoring slots with a teacher.
Tests on a fixed calendar, all on an online portal that works like the real JEE, each with a personal analysis.

questions.q: My child is in Class 10. Which programme fits?

a.text: The two-year programme. It starts in June after Class 10, with a foundation period from April.

questions.q: Can a student join in Class 12?

a.text: Yes, through the one-year programme for Class 12.

questions.q: Is there a batch for students taking a drop year?

a.text: No. Our programmes are for students in school.

questions.a: Fees depend on the programme. Call us on {{fact:contact.phone}} and we will explain them.
